question: Who among the following Indian music directors, specially known as a leading drummer of India, was awarded the Padma Shri in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**"Sivamani".**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sivamani **is a well-known **Indian percussionist and music composer** who is considered to be one of the **leading drummers **in India.
 
• He has worked with many famous musicians and composers in the** Indian film industry **and has also collaborated with international artists.
 
• In** 2019, **Sivamani was awarded the **Padma Shri,** which is one of the **highest civilian honors **in India, for his contribution to the field of music.
 
• Apart from his work as a drummer and composer, Sivamani has also been involved in various **philanthropic activities.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nucleya** is a popular** Indian electronic music producer** who has gained a lot of popularity in recent years.

 
 
• His real name is **Udyan Sagar.**
 
 
 
• **Bappi Lahiri** is a veteran music composer and singer in the Indian film industry.
 
 
• **Guinness World Records** recognized him in **1986 **for having recorded over 180 songs in a single year.
 
 
 
• **Naushad** was a legendary music composer in the Indian film industry who is known for his work in the 1940s-60s. 
 
 
• In **1981 and 1992**, Naushad received the **Dadasaheb Phalke Award** and the **Padma Bhushan.**
